steps.look: (() => { const C = N.controller, d = G.stage.part('dinerFront').door; const b = d.makeBar().pivot; b.updateMatrixWorld(true); const p = new N.THREE.Vector3(-0.035, 0, -0.42).applyMatrix4(b.matrixWorld), e = G.eye; const yaw = Math.atan2(-(p.x - e.x), -(p.z - e.z)), pt = Math.atan2(p.y - e.y, Math.hypot(p.x - e.x, p.z - e.z)); const dy = Math.atan2(Math.sin(yaw - C.yaw), Math.cos(yaw - C.yaw)); return [Math.round(-dy / C.sensitivity), Math.round(-(pt - C.pitch) / C.sensitivity)]; })()
